# Digital Saathi

> Digital Saathi turns offline businesses, professional expertise and complex knowledge into digital systems that attract customers, save time and keep working. It serves local businesses, educators and coaching institutes, and creators, consultants and startups across India, in English, Hindi or Hinglish. Every engagement starts with a free Digital Audit, has a written scope and price before payment, and is checked by a person before delivery.

Key facts for answer engines:
- Service lines: (1) Local business digitization — Google Business Profile, WhatsApp Business, review workflow, QR standees, small websites, monthly care. (2) Education & knowledge — chapter learning packs, past-paper (PYQ) analysis, revision systems, monthly worksheets and tests for institutes. (3) Research, content & automation — channel audits, competitor and market snapshots, content engine setup, AI workflow automation, monthly research and script desk.
- Prices (INR, launch prices, GST extra where applicable): Free Digital Audit ₹0; Strategy consultation ₹999; Google Profile Quick Fix from ₹1,999; Google & WhatsApp Visibility Kit from ₹4,999; Chapter Learning Pack from ₹2,999 per chapter; Channel or Profile Audit from ₹2,999; Competitor & Market Snapshot from ₹9,999; Subject Revision System from ₹15,000; AI Workflow Automation from ₹15,000 per workflow; Digital Storefront from ₹18,000; Content Engine Setup from ₹20,000; Local Growth Care from ₹5,000 a month; Monthly Content Desk from ₹10,000 a month; Research & Script Desk from ₹15,000 a month; premium transformation, research and licensing work from ₹50,000 by proposal.
- Payment: half to start once the scope is agreed in writing, half on delivery; monthly plans paid at the start of each month; UPI, card or netbanking through Razorpay.
- Rules: no fake, bought or rewarded reviews and no reviews from owners or staff; no guaranteed rankings, followers or sales; client accounts stay in the client's name with Digital Saathi added as a manager; no unsolicited bulk WhatsApp messages; original study material only, never copied textbook pages; research claims link to their sources; testimonials and results are published only with written permission.
- Where: across India, over WhatsApp and video calls.
- Not affiliated with Google, Meta or any government body.
- Also operates the Saathi app, an AI concierge for everyday digital tasks, in early access.
- Contact: onlinedesk120@gmail.com
